requirements.quote: Each Dockerfile builds with BuildKit, runs as a non-root UID, has no package manager caches in the final layer, and the final image size is under budget (web under 350 MB, api and worker under 250 MB) [type:unit]
requirements.evidence: images.yml size-gate step measures size; non-root and cache rules statically asserted in compose-prod.test.mjs

requirements.quote: `compose.prod.yml` starts caddy, web x2, api, worker x2, admin, postgres and minio with healthchecks; `docker compose up -d` reaches healthy for all services within 120 s in CI [type:api]
No container runs privileged; `cap_drop: [ALL]`, `no-new-privileges`, read-only root filesystem with tmpfs where needed, asserted by a compose lint script [type:unit]

Only Caddy publishes ports 80 and 443 (and 443/udp for HTTP/3); Postgres, MinIO, admin and internal services are on a private network and unreachable from outside, verified by a port scan in the smoke test [type:api]
requirements.evidence: images.yml compose-smoke job port scan; static port check in compose-prod.test.mjs is in-lane

requirements.quote: Postgres image bundles pgvector and the WAL-G binary; `archive_mode=on` and `archive_command` point at WAL-G with env-provided storage, defaulting to a local MinIO bucket in CI [type:api]

The app database role is not the owner so RLS is enforced; migrations run through the owner role in a one-off container; the smoke test asserts RLS-forced tables reject cross-workspace reads [type:api]
All services read configuration only from env validated by the shared env schema; booting with a missing required variable fails fast with a clear message [type:unit]
requirements.evidence: compose-smoke.sh boots a service with a missing variable and asserts non-zero exit; packages/config already validates

requirements.quote: No service writes outside declared volumes or tmpfs; verified with a read-only filesystem run of the smoke test [type:api]
requirements.evidence: images.yml compose-smoke job runs with read_only: true

requirements.quote: Images are multi-arch, tagged `sha-<gitsha>` and `main`, pushed to GHCR, scanned by Trivy (fail on critical with fix available), and signed with cosign; SBOM attached [type:manual]

Resource limits (memory and CPU) are set for every service and documented, sized for a 4 vCPU and 8 GB VPS within the cost target of about ₹6 to 12k per month for staging and prod combined [type:manual]

`bootstrap-vps.sh` is idempotent: running twice makes no changes the second time; it configures firewall (only 22 limited by allowlist, 80, 443), fail2ban, unattended security upgrades and time sync (chrony) [type:manual]
requirements.evidence: needs a real VPS (#108); in-lane is bash -n and guard-pattern review

requirements.quote: Timezone and clocks: containers log in UTC, host NTP is verified by a startup check that fails readiness if drift exceeds 1 s [type:api]
Staging runs the same compose with `staging.env.example` overrides and smaller limits, using preview data only [type:manual]
